zh-TW.text: 從C03核准架構飛向晶粒介面文件，每個接點都需要身分與預定連接。
zh-TW.english: Fly from C03's approved architecture to the die-interface documents, where every contact needs an identity and an intended connection.

zh-TW.text: C04產生具版本的凸塊與電源網路圖，不是已完成布線的封裝。
zh-TW.english: C04 produces a versioned bump and power-net map, not a finished routed package.

zh-TW.text: 晶粒實例、接點編號、實體座標與電氣網路必須分開，不能用一個色塊同時代替四者。
zh-TW.english: We must distinguish the die instance, pad identifier, physical coordinate, and electrical net instead of treating a coloured square as all four.

zh-TW.text: 檢查連接基線後，詳細晶粒擺位與組裝可達性才交給C05。
zh-TW.english: Detailed die placement and assembly access belong to C05 after this connectivity baseline is checked.

zh-TW.text: 降到假想八欄六列格點，教學間距為250微米。
zh-TW.english: Descend onto an invented eight-column, six-row grid with a teaching pitch of 250 micrometres.

zh-TW.text: A到H欄由左至右，第一到第六列由下至上，原點位於陣列中心。
zh-TW.english: Columns A through H run left to right, rows one through six run bottom to top, and the origin is the array centre.

zh-TW.text: 明示的晶粒正面視圖以x向右、y向上，因此B2位於負0.625與負0.375mm。
zh-TW.english: This declared die-front view has x pointing right and y pointing up, so B2 is at minus 0.625 and minus 0.375 millimetres.

zh-TW.text: 這些是示範座標，不是供應商凸塊尺寸，也不是通用匯入方向。
zh-TW.english: These are demonstration coordinates, not a supplier's bump dimensions or a universal import orientation.

zh-TW.text: 跟隨B2進行明示轉換，先以局部y軸鏡射x，再逆時針旋轉九十度，最後平移10與20mm。
zh-TW.english: Follow B2 through our declared transform: mirror x through the local y axis, rotate ninety degrees counterclockwise, then translate by ten and twenty millimetres.

zh-TW.text: 結果為封裝X等於10減局部y，封裝Y等於20減局部x。
zh-TW.english: The resulting formula is package X equals ten minus local y, and package Y equals twenty minus local x.
B2 therefore lands at 10.375 and 20.625 millimetres.

zh-TW.text: 鏡射與旋轉順序互換會改變結果，除了外框，也須檢查獨立且不對稱的參考點。
zh-TW.english: Reversing mirror and rotation changes the result, so inspect independent asymmetric reference points as well as the outline.

zh-TW.text: 升到四十八個候選位置上方，移除四個禁放角點與本例不放凸塊的四個預留位置。
zh-TW.english: Rise above all forty-eight candidate sites, then remove four keep-out corners and four reserved sites that have no bump in this exercise.

zh-TW.text: 剩餘四十個電氣接點包含二十訊號、八個CORE供電、四個IO供電與八個接地。
zh-TW.english: The remaining forty electrical pads contain twenty signals, eight CORE supply pads, four IO supply pads, and eight ground pads.

zh-TW.text: 多個供電接點可刻意共用網路，但接點編號在同一晶粒實例內必須唯一。
zh-TW.english: Repeated supply-net names intentionally share a net, while pad identifiers must remain unique within their die instance.

zh-TW.text: 排除位置不等於已安裝的無連接接點，單靠顏色也無法證明兩者。
zh-TW.english: An excluded site is not the same as an installed no-connect pad, and colour alone proves neither case.

zh-TW.text: 放大CORE、IO與參考網路的獨立紀錄，不把所有名為VDD的網路合併。
zh-TW.english: Zoom into separate CORE, IO, and reference-net records instead of merging everything named VDD.

zh-TW.text: 本例假設CORE為0.8V、IO為1.2V，並明示共用一個參考網路。
zh-TW.english: Our invented domains are 0.8 volts for CORE and 1.2 volts for IO, with a deliberately shared reference in this example.

zh-TW.text: 訊號對應也需要明確語意，例如發送端正接點經具名封裝網路連至接收端正接點。
zh-TW.english: Signal mapping also needs explicit meaning: a transmitter's positive contact may connect to a receiver's positive contact through a named package net.

zh-TW.text: 名稱對應、極性交換或不同電壓域連接，都須有核准介面規則，不能憑圖猜測。
zh-TW.english: Matching names, exchanging polarity, or joining different voltage domains requires an approved interface rule, never a visual guess.

zh-TW.text: 俯瞰假設靜態負載，CORE為8A，IO為2A。
zh-TW.english: Look down on the assumed static loads: eight amperes on CORE and two on IO.

zh-TW.text: 若均分，八個CORE接點各1A，四個IO接點各0.5A。
zh-TW.english: Equal sharing would give one ampere across each of eight CORE pads and half an ampere across each of four IO pads.

zh-TW.text: 兩電源域均經八個參考接點回流時，簡化平均為每個1.25A。
zh-TW.english: With both rails returning through the eight reference pads, the simplified average there is 1.25 amperes.

zh-TW.text: 這些平均值不能確立局部電流、實體接點額定、暫態行為或已驗證電源網路。
zh-TW.english: These averages do not establish local current, physical pad ratings, transient behaviour, or a qualified power network.

zh-TW.text: 移到理想兩節點電路，八條CORE供電支路並聯，總電流固定8A。
zh-TW.english: Move to an ideal two-node circuit containing eight parallel CORE supply branches, with total current fixed at eight amperes.

zh-TW.text: 每條都是8毫歐時各流1A，但只把其中一條改成4毫歐，它便約流1.778A。
zh-TW.english: When every branch is eight milliohms, each carries one ampere, but reducing just one branch to four milliohms makes it carry about 1.778 amperes.

zh-TW.text: 即使平均仍為1A，該支路已超過假設的1.2A篩檢門檻。
zh-TW.english: That exceeds our invented 1.2-ampere screening threshold even though the average remains one.

zh-TW.text: 電路說明不均流，不是量測凸塊電阻或製造電流額定。
zh-TW.english: The circuit illustrates unequal sharing, not measured bump resistance or a manufacturing current rating.

zh-TW.text: 沿CORE的8A供電及共用參考回流前進，回流承載CORE的8A加IO的2A。
zh-TW.english: Follow CORE's eight-ampere supply and the shared reference return carrying eight CORE plus two IO amperes.

zh-TW.text: 假設CORE供電路徑2毫歐、共用回流3毫歐，CORE供電壓降為8乘2加10乘3，也就是46毫伏。
zh-TW.english: With a hypothetical two-milliohm CORE supply path and three-milliohm shared return, the CORE delivery drop is eight times two plus ten times three, or forty-six millivolts.

zh-TW.text: 它超出40毫伏預算，若錯把兩段都用8A計算，就會漏掉6毫伏。
zh-TW.english: That fails the forty-millivolt budget, while incorrectly using eight amperes for both paths would hide six millivolts.

zh-TW.text: 扣除30毫伏回流貢獻後，CORE供電只剩10毫伏，因此最多允許1.25毫歐。
zh-TW.english: After the thirty-millivolt return contribution, only ten millivolts remain for CORE supply, allowing at most 1.25 milliohms.

zh-TW.text: 停在刻意錯誤的接點圖，它違反明定契約，先旋轉再鏡射。
zh-TW.english: Freeze a deliberately wrong map that rotates before mirroring, contrary to the declared contract.

zh-TW.text: CORE接點B2落到原本接地G5的位置，但對稱外框與接點總數仍可能看似合理。
zh-TW.english: Its CORE pad B2 lands at the position intended for ground pad G5, although the symmetric outline and total pad count still look plausible.

zh-TW.text: 應以獨立座標見證與具類型端點連接拒絕錯配，不是重塗色塊或豁免錯誤。
zh-TW.english: Reject the mismatch using independent coordinate witnesses and typed endpoint connectivity, rather than recolouring the square or waiving the error.

zh-TW.text: 在這張圖中，再有利的電流平均也不能使供電接參考網路變成合格。
zh-TW.english: No amount of favourable current averaging makes a supply-to-reference connection acceptable in this map.

zh-TW.text: 拉遠到交付紀錄，包含輸入版本、座標慣例、明示網路別名與每個已安裝接點的身分。
zh-TW.english: Pull back to a release record containing the input revision, coordinate convention, explicit net aliases, and every installed pad's identity.

zh-TW.text: 附上方向與連接檢查、電源預算假設、未解證據，以及核准變更歷史。
zh-TW.english: Attach orientation and connectivity checks, power-budget assumptions, unresolved evidence, and the approved change history.

zh-TW.text: C04交付可追溯圖供後續實體及電氣驗證，不宣稱布線、可靠度或載流能力已簽核。
zh-TW.english: C04 delivers a traceable map for later physical and electrical verification, not a claim that routing, reliability, or current capacity is already signed off.

zh-TW.text: C05便能使用同一受控介面基線，安排晶粒並預留組裝存取空間。
zh-TW.english: C05 can now place dies and reserve assembly access using the same controlled interface baseline.

ja.text: C03で承認した構造からダイのインターフェース文書へ飛び、各接点の識別と意図した接続を確認します。
ja.english: Fly from C03's approved architecture to the die-interface documents, where every contact needs an identity and an intended connection.

ja.text: C04で作るのは版管理されたバンプと電源ネットの図であり、配線済みパッケージではありません。
ja.english: C04 produces a versioned bump and power-net map, not a finished routed package.

ja.text: ダイのインスタンス、パッド識別子、物理座標、電気ネットを区別し、一つの色付きマスで全てを表さないようにします。
ja.english: We must distinguish the die instance, pad identifier, physical coordinate, and electrical net instead of treating a coloured square as all four.

ja.text: 接続の基準を確認してから、詳細なダイ配置と組立時のアクセスをC05で扱います。
ja.english: Detailed die placement and assembly access belong to C05 after this connectivity baseline is checked.

ja.text: 仮想の八列六行の格子へ降下し、教材用の間隔を250マイクロメートルとします。
ja.english: Descend onto an invented eight-column, six-row grid with a teaching pitch of 250 micrometres.

ja.text: 列AからHは左から右へ、行一から六は下から上へ増え、原点は配列の中心です。
ja.english: Columns A through H run left to right, rows one through six run bottom to top, and the origin is the array centre.

ja.text: 定義したダイ表面の視点ではxが右、yが上を向き、B2はマイナス0.625とマイナス0.375ミリメートルにあります。
ja.english: This declared die-front view has x pointing right and y pointing up, so B2 is at minus 0.625 and minus 0.375 millimetres.

ja.text: これは説明用の座標であり、供給者のバンプ寸法や汎用の読み込み方向ではありません。
ja.english: These are demonstration coordinates, not a supplier's bump dimensions or a universal import orientation.

ja.text: B2を追い、まず局所y軸に対してxを鏡映し、次に反時計回りに九十度回転し、最後に十と二十ミリメートル平行移動します。
ja.english: Follow B2 through our declared transform: mirror x through the local y axis, rotate ninety degrees counterclockwise, then translate by ten and twenty millimetres.

ja.text: 得られる式は、パッケージXが十から局所yを引いた値、Yが二十から局所xを引いた値です。
ja.english: The resulting formula is package X equals ten minus local y, and package Y equals twenty minus local x.

ja.text: したがってB2は10.375と20.625ミリメートルに移ります。
ja.english: B2 therefore lands at 10.375 and 20.625 millimetres.

ja.text: 鏡映と回転の順序を逆にすると結果が変わるため、外形だけでなく独立した非対称の基準点も確認します。
ja.english: Reversing mirror and rotation changes the result, so inspect independent asymmetric reference points as well as the outline.

ja.text: 四十八の候補位置を俯瞰し、配置禁止の四隅と、この演習ではバンプを置かない四つの予約位置を取り除きます。
ja.english: Rise above all forty-eight candidate sites, then remove four keep-out corners and four reserved sites that have no bump in this exercise.

ja.text: 残る四十の電気パッドは、信号二十、CORE電源八、IO電源四、接地八です。
ja.english: The remaining forty electrical pads contain twenty signals, eight CORE supply pads, four IO supply pads, and eight ground pads.

ja.text: 電源ネット名の繰り返しは意図した共有ですが、同じダイのインスタンス内ではパッド識別子が一意でなければなりません。
ja.english: Repeated supply-net names intentionally share a net, while pad identifiers must remain unique within their die instance.

ja.text: 除外位置と実装された未接続パッドは別であり、色だけではどちらも証明できません。
ja.english: An excluded site is not the same as an installed no-connect pad, and colour alone proves neither case.

ja.text: CORE、IO、基準ネットの別々の記録へ近づき、VDDという名前だけで全てを統合しないようにします。
ja.english: Zoom into separate CORE, IO, and reference-net records instead of merging everything named VDD.

ja.text: 仮想の電源領域はCOREが0.8ボルト、IOが1.2ボルトで、この例では基準を明示的に共有します。
ja.english: Our invented domains are 0.8 volts for CORE and 1.2 volts for IO, with a deliberately shared reference in this example.

ja.text: 信号の対応にも明確な意味が必要で、例えば送信側の正端子を名前付きパッケージネット経由で受信側の正端子へ接続します。
ja.english: Signal mapping also needs explicit meaning: a transmitter's positive contact may connect to a receiver's positive contact through a named package net.

ja.text: 名前の対応、極性交換、異なる電圧領域の接続には承認済みのインターフェース規則が必要で、見た目で推測してはいけません。
ja.english: Matching names, exchanging polarity, or joining different voltage domains requires an approved interface rule, never a visual guess.

ja.text: 仮定した静的負荷を俯瞰すると、COREは八アンペア、IOは二アンペアです。
ja.english: Look down on the assumed static loads: eight amperes on CORE and two on IO.

ja.text: 均等に分担すれば、八つのCOREパッドは各一アンペア、四つのIOパッドは各0.5アンペアです。
ja.english: Equal sharing would give one ampere across each of eight CORE pads and half an ampere across each of four IO pads.

ja.text: 両電源が八つの基準パッドを通って戻る場合、その単純化した平均は各1.25アンペアです。
ja.english: With both rails returning through the eight reference pads, the simplified average there is 1.25 amperes.

ja.text: この平均では局所電流、実際のパッド定格、過渡挙動、電源網の適格性を確定できません。
ja.english: These averages do not establish local current, physical pad ratings, transient behaviour, or a qualified power network.

ja.text: 理想的な二節点間に八本のCORE電源枝を並列接続し、総電流を八アンペアに固定した回路へ移ります。
ja.english: Move to an ideal two-node circuit containing eight parallel CORE supply branches, with total current fixed at eight amperes.

ja.text: 各枝が八ミリオームなら一アンペアずつですが、一枝だけ四ミリオームにすると、その枝は約1.778アンペアになります。
ja.english: When every branch is eight milliohms, each carries one ampere, but reducing just one branch to four milliohms makes it carry about 1.778 amperes.

ja.text: 平均は一アンペアのままでも、仮定した1.2アンペアの確認しきい値を超えます。
ja.english: That exceeds our invented 1.2-ampere screening threshold even though the average remains one.

ja.text: これは不均等な電流分担の説明であり、実測バンプ抵抗や製造上の電流定格ではありません。
ja.english: The circuit illustrates unequal sharing, not measured bump resistance or a manufacturing current rating.

ja.text: COREの八アンペアの供給と、COREの八アンペアにIOの二アンペアを加えた共有基準帰還を追います。
ja.english: Follow CORE's eight-ampere supply and the shared reference return carrying eight CORE plus two IO amperes.

ja.text: 仮にCORE供給経路が二ミリオーム、共有帰還が三ミリオームなら、COREへの供給電圧降下は八掛ける二と十掛ける三の和で四十六ミリボルトです。
ja.english: With a hypothetical two-milliohm CORE supply path and three-milliohm shared return, the CORE delivery drop is eight times two plus ten times three, or forty-six millivolts.

ja.text: これは四十ミリボルトの予算を超え、両経路を誤って八アンペアで計算すると六ミリボルトを見落とします。
ja.english: That fails the forty-millivolt budget, while incorrectly using eight amperes for both paths would hide six millivolts.

ja.text: 帰還の三十ミリボルトを差し引くとCORE供給には十ミリボルトだけが残り、許容抵抗は最大1.25ミリオームです。
ja.english: After the thirty-millivolt return contribution, only ten millivolts remain for CORE supply, allowing at most 1.25 milliohms.

ja.text: 定義した契約に反し、鏡映より先に回転する意図的な誤りのある図で停止します。
ja.english: Freeze a deliberately wrong map that rotates before mirroring, contrary to the declared contract.

ja.text: COREパッドB2が接地パッドG5の予定位置へ移っても、対称な外形とパッド総数は妥当に見えることがあります。
ja.english: Its CORE pad B2 lands at the position intended for ground pad G5, although the symmetric outline and total pad count still look plausible.

ja.text: 色を塗り直したり誤りを免除したりせず、独立した座標の確認点と型を持つ端点接続で不一致を拒否します。
ja.english: Reject the mismatch using independent coordinate witnesses and typed endpoint connectivity, rather than recolouring the square or waiving the error.

ja.text: 平均電流がどれほど好ましくても、この図で電源を基準へ接続することは許容されません。
ja.english: No amount of favourable current averaging makes a supply-to-reference connection acceptable in this map.

ja.text: 引いて全体を見渡し、入力版、座標規約、明示したネット別名、各実装パッドの識別を含むリリース記録を確認します。
ja.english: Pull back to a release record containing the input revision, coordinate convention, explicit net aliases, and every installed pad's identity.

ja.text: 向きと接続の検査、電源予算の仮定、未解決の根拠、承認した変更履歴を添付します。
ja.english: Attach orientation and connectivity checks, power-budget assumptions, unresolved evidence, and the approved change history.

ja.text: C04は後続の物理・電気検証に使う追跡可能な図を渡し、配線、信頼性、電流容量の承認完了を主張しません。
ja.english: C04 delivers a traceable map for later physical and electrical verification, not a claim that routing, reliability, or current capacity is already signed off.

ja.text: C05では同じ管理されたインターフェース基準を用いて、ダイを配置し組立アクセスを確保します。
ja.english: C05 can now place dies and reserve assembly access using the same controlled interface baseline.

ko.text: C03에서 승인한 구조에서 다이 인터페이스 문서로 이동하며 각 접점의 식별자와 의도한 연결을 확인합니다.
ko.english: Fly from C03's approved architecture to the die-interface documents, where every contact needs an identity and an intended connection.

ko.text: C04의 산출물은 버전이 관리되는 범프 및 전원 네트 맵이며 배선이 끝난 패키지가 아닙니다.
ko.english: C04 produces a versioned bump and power-net map, not a finished routed package.

ko.text: 다이 인스턴스, 패드 식별자, 물리 좌표, 전기 네트를 구분하고 하나의 색상 칸으로 네 가지 모두를 대신하지 않습니다.
ko.english: We must distinguish the die instance, pad identifier, physical coordinate, and electrical net instead of treating a coloured square as all four.

ko.text: 연결 기준을 확인한 뒤 상세한 다이 배치와 조립 접근성은 C05에서 다룹니다.
ko.english: Detailed die placement and assembly access belong to C05 after this connectivity baseline is checked.

ko.text: 가상의 여덟 열 여섯 행 격자로 내려가며 교육용 간격은 250마이크로미터로 정합니다.
ko.english: Descend onto an invented eight-column, six-row grid with a teaching pitch of 250 micrometres.

ko.text: A부터 H 열은 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로, 첫째부터 여섯째 행은 아래에서 위로 증가하며 원점은 배열 중심입니다.
ko.english: Columns A through H run left to right, rows one through six run bottom to top, and the origin is the array centre.

ko.text: 정의한 다이 앞면 보기에서는 x가 오른쪽, y가 위쪽이므로 B2 좌표는 마이너스 0.625와 마이너스 0.375밀리미터입니다.
ko.english: This declared die-front view has x pointing right and y pointing up, so B2 is at minus 0.625 and minus 0.375 millimetres.

ko.text: 이는 시범 좌표이며 공급업체의 범프 치수나 보편적인 가져오기 방향이 아닙니다.
ko.english: These are demonstration coordinates, not a supplier's bump dimensions or a universal import orientation.

ko.text: B2를 따라 먼저 로컬 y축에 대해 x를 미러링하고 반시계 방향으로 구십 도 회전한 뒤 십과 이십 밀리미터만큼 평행 이동합니다.
ko.english: Follow B2 through our declared transform: mirror x through the local y axis, rotate ninety degrees counterclockwise, then translate by ten and twenty millimetres.

ko.text: 결과식은 패키지 X가 십에서 로컬 y를 뺀 값이고 Y가 이십에서 로컬 x를 뺀 값입니다.
ko.english: The resulting formula is package X equals ten minus local y, and package Y equals twenty minus local x.

ko.text: 따라서 B2는 10.375와 20.625밀리미터에 놓입니다.
ko.english: B2 therefore lands at 10.375 and 20.625 millimetres.

ko.text: 미러링과 회전 순서를 바꾸면 결과가 달라지므로 외곽선뿐 아니라 독립적인 비대칭 기준점도 확인합니다.
ko.english: Reversing mirror and rotation changes the result, so inspect independent asymmetric reference points as well as the outline.

ko.text: 마흔여덟 후보 위치를 내려다보고 배치 금지인 네 모서리와 이 연습에서 범프를 놓지 않는 네 예약 위치를 제외합니다.
ko.english: Rise above all forty-eight candidate sites, then remove four keep-out corners and four reserved sites that have no bump in this exercise.

ko.text: 남은 마흔 개 전기 패드는 신호 스무 개, CORE 전원 여덟 개, IO 전원 네 개, 접지 여덟 개입니다.
ko.english: The remaining forty electrical pads contain twenty signals, eight CORE supply pads, four IO supply pads, and eight ground pads.

ko.text: 전원 네트 이름의 반복은 의도한 공유이지만 같은 다이 인스턴스 안의 패드 식별자는 유일해야 합니다.
ko.english: Repeated supply-net names intentionally share a net, while pad identifiers must remain unique within their die instance.

ko.text: 제외된 위치는 설치된 미연결 패드와 다르며 색상만으로 어느 쪽도 증명할 수 없습니다.
ko.english: An excluded site is not the same as an installed no-connect pad, and colour alone proves neither case.

ko.text: CORE, IO, 기준 네트의 별도 기록을 확대하며 VDD라는 이름만으로 모두 합치지 않습니다.
ko.english: Zoom into separate CORE, IO, and reference-net records instead of merging everything named VDD.

ko.text: 가정한 전원 도메인은 CORE 0.8볼트와 IO 1.2볼트이며 이 예에서는 기준을 명시적으로 공유합니다.
ko.english: Our invented domains are 0.8 volts for CORE and 1.2 volts for IO, with a deliberately shared reference in this example.

ko.text: 신호 매핑에도 명확한 의미가 필요하며 송신 측 양의 접점이 이름 있는 패키지 네트를 거쳐 수신 측 양의 접점에 연결되는 것이 한 예입니다.
ko.english: Signal mapping also needs explicit meaning: a transmitter's positive contact may connect to a receiver's positive contact through a named package net.

ko.text: 이름 대응, 극성 교환, 서로 다른 전압 도메인 연결에는 승인된 인터페이스 규칙이 필요하며 외형으로 추측하면 안 됩니다.
ko.english: Matching names, exchanging polarity, or joining different voltage domains requires an approved interface rule, never a visual guess.

ko.text: 가정한 정적 부하를 내려다보면 CORE는 팔 암페어이고 IO는 이 암페어입니다.
ko.english: Look down on the assumed static loads: eight amperes on CORE and two on IO.

ko.text: 균등 분담이라면 여덟 CORE 패드는 각각 일 암페어, 네 IO 패드는 각각 0.5암페어입니다.
ko.english: Equal sharing would give one ampere across each of eight CORE pads and half an ampere across each of four IO pads.

ko.text: 두 전원이 모두 여덟 기준 패드로 귀환할 때 단순 평균은 각각 1.25암페어입니다.
ko.english: With both rails returning through the eight reference pads, the simplified average there is 1.25 amperes.

ko.text: 이 평균은 국부 전류, 실제 패드 정격, 과도 동작이나 검증된 전원망을 확정하지 못합니다.
ko.english: These averages do not establish local current, physical pad ratings, transient behaviour, or a qualified power network.

ko.text: 이상적인 두 노드 사이에 여덟 CORE 공급 분기를 병렬로 놓고 총전류를 팔 암페어로 고정한 회로로 이동합니다.
ko.english: Move to an ideal two-node circuit containing eight parallel CORE supply branches, with total current fixed at eight amperes.

ko.text: 각 분기가 팔 밀리옴이면 각각 일 암페어지만 하나만 사 밀리옴으로 바꾸면 그 분기에는 약 1.778암페어가 흐릅니다.
ko.english: When every branch is eight milliohms, each carries one ampere, but reducing just one branch to four milliohms makes it carry about 1.778 amperes.

ko.text: 평균은 일 암페어로 같아도 가정한 1.2암페어 선별 기준을 초과합니다.
ko.english: That exceeds our invented 1.2-ampere screening threshold even though the average remains one.

ko.text: 이 회로는 불균등한 전류 분담을 설명하며 측정한 범프 저항이나 제조 전류 정격이 아닙니다.
ko.english: The circuit illustrates unequal sharing, not measured bump resistance or a manufacturing current rating.

ko.text: CORE의 팔 암페어 공급과 CORE 팔 암페어에 IO 이 암페어를 더한 공유 기준 귀환을 추적합니다.
ko.english: Follow CORE's eight-ampere supply and the shared reference return carrying eight CORE plus two IO amperes.

ko.text: 가정한 CORE 공급 경로가 이 밀리옴이고 공유 귀환이 삼 밀리옴이면 CORE 전달 전압 강하는 팔 곱하기 이에 십 곱하기 삼을 더한 사십육 밀리볼트입니다.
ko.english: With a hypothetical two-milliohm CORE supply path and three-milliohm shared return, the CORE delivery drop is eight times two plus ten times three, or forty-six millivolts.

ko.text: 이는 사십 밀리볼트 예산을 초과하며 두 경로에 모두 팔 암페어를 잘못 적용하면 육 밀리볼트를 놓칩니다.
ko.english: That fails the forty-millivolt budget, while incorrectly using eight amperes for both paths would hide six millivolts.

ko.text: 귀환의 삼십 밀리볼트를 빼면 CORE 공급에는 십 밀리볼트만 남아 허용 저항은 최대 1.25밀리옴입니다.
ko.english: After the thirty-millivolt return contribution, only ten millivolts remain for CORE supply, allowing at most 1.25 milliohms.

ko.text: 정의한 계약과 달리 미러링 전에 회전하는 의도적인 오류 맵에서 멈춥니다.
ko.english: Freeze a deliberately wrong map that rotates before mirroring, contrary to the declared contract.

ko.text: CORE 패드 B2가 접지 패드 G5의 예정 위치에 놓여도 대칭 외곽선과 총 패드 수는 그럴듯해 보일 수 있습니다.
ko.english: Its CORE pad B2 lands at the position intended for ground pad G5, although the symmetric outline and total pad count still look plausible.

ko.text: 색상을 바꾸거나 오류를 면제하지 말고 독립적인 좌표 확인점과 유형이 지정된 끝점 연결로 불일치를 거부합니다.
ko.english: Reject the mismatch using independent coordinate witnesses and typed endpoint connectivity, rather than recolouring the square or waiving the error.

ko.text: 평균 전류가 아무리 유리해도 이 맵의 공급과 기준 간 오접속은 허용되지 않습니다.
ko.english: No amount of favourable current averaging makes a supply-to-reference connection acceptable in this map.

ko.text: 입력 버전, 좌표 규약, 명시한 네트 별칭, 각 설치 패드의 식별자를 담은 인계 기록으로 시야를 넓힙니다.
ko.english: Pull back to a release record containing the input revision, coordinate convention, explicit net aliases, and every installed pad's identity.

ko.text: 방향 및 연결 검사, 전원 예산 가정, 미해결 근거와 승인된 변경 이력을 첨부합니다.
ko.english: Attach orientation and connectivity checks, power-budget assumptions, unresolved evidence, and the approved change history.

ko.text: C04는 이후 물리 및 전기 검증을 위한 추적 가능한 맵을 제공하며 배선, 신뢰성 또는 전류 용량의 최종 승인을 주장하지 않습니다.
ko.english: C04 delivers a traceable map for later physical and electrical verification, not a claim that routing, reliability, or current capacity is already signed off.

ko.text: C05는 같은 통제된 인터페이스 기준으로 다이를 배치하고 조립 접근 공간을 확보합니다.
ko.english: C05 can now place dies and reserve assembly access using the same controlled interface baseline.

zh-CN.text: 从C03批准架构飞向裸片接口文件，每个接点都需要身份与预定连接。
zh-CN.english: Fly from C03's approved architecture to the die-interface documents, where every contact needs an identity and an intended connection.

zh-CN.text: C04产生具版本的凸块与电源网络图，不是已完成布线的封装。
zh-CN.english: C04 produces a versioned bump and power-net map, not a finished routed package.

zh-CN.text: 裸片实例、接点编号、物理坐标与电气网络必须分开，不能用一个色块同时代替四者。
zh-CN.english: We must distinguish the die instance, pad identifier, physical coordinate, and electrical net instead of treating a coloured square as all four.

zh-CN.text: 检查连接基线后，详细裸片放置与组装可达性才交给C05。
zh-CN.english: Detailed die placement and assembly access belong to C05 after this connectivity baseline is checked.

zh-CN.text: 降到假想八栏六列格点，教学间距为250微米。
zh-CN.english: Descend onto an invented eight-column, six-row grid with a teaching pitch of 250 micrometres.

zh-CN.text: A到H栏由左至右，第一到第六列由下至上，原点位于阵列中心。
zh-CN.english: Columns A through H run left to right, rows one through six run bottom to top, and the origin is the array centre.

zh-CN.text: 明示的裸片正面视图以x向右、y向上，因此B2位于负0.625与负0.375mm。
zh-CN.english: This declared die-front view has x pointing right and y pointing up, so B2 is at minus 0.625 and minus 0.375 millimetres.

zh-CN.text: 这些是示范坐标，不是供应商凸块尺寸，也不是通用导入方向。
zh-CN.english: These are demonstration coordinates, not a supplier's bump dimensions or a universal import orientation.

zh-CN.text: 跟随B2进行明示转换，先以局部y轴镜射x，再逆时针旋转九十度，最后平移10与20mm。
zh-CN.english: Follow B2 through our declared transform: mirror x through the local y axis, rotate ninety degrees counterclockwise, then translate by ten and twenty millimetres.

zh-CN.text: 结果为封装X等于10减局部y，封装Y等于20减局部x。
zh-CN.english: The resulting formula is package X equals ten minus local y, and package Y equals twenty minus local x.
B2 therefore lands at 10.375 and 20.625 millimetres.

zh-CN.text: 镜射与旋转顺序互换会改变结果，除了外框，也须检查独立且不对称的参考点。
zh-CN.english: Reversing mirror and rotation changes the result, so inspect independent asymmetric reference points as well as the outline.

zh-CN.text: 升到四十八个候选位置上方，移除四个禁放角点与本例不放凸块的四个预留位置。
zh-CN.english: Rise above all forty-eight candidate sites, then remove four keep-out corners and four reserved sites that have no bump in this exercise.

zh-CN.text: 剩余四十个电气接点包含二十信号、八个CORE供电、四个IO供电与八个接地。
zh-CN.english: The remaining forty electrical pads contain twenty signals, eight CORE supply pads, four IO supply pads, and eight ground pads.

zh-CN.text: 多个供电接点可刻意共用网络，但接点编号在同一裸片实例内必须唯一。
zh-CN.english: Repeated supply-net names intentionally share a net, while pad identifiers must remain unique within their die instance.

zh-CN.text: 排除位置不等于已安装的无连接接点，单靠颜色也无法证明两者。
zh-CN.english: An excluded site is not the same as an installed no-connect pad, and colour alone proves neither case.

zh-CN.text: 放大CORE、IO与参考网络的独立记录，不把所有名为VDD的网络合并。
zh-CN.english: Zoom into separate CORE, IO, and reference-net records instead of merging everything named VDD.

zh-CN.text: 本例假设CORE为0.8V、IO为1.2V，并明示共用一个参考网络。
zh-CN.english: Our invented domains are 0.8 volts for CORE and 1.2 volts for IO, with a deliberately shared reference in this example.

zh-CN.text: 信号对应也需要明确语意，例如发送端正接点经具名封装网络连至接收端正接点。
zh-CN.english: Signal mapping also needs explicit meaning: a transmitter's positive contact may connect to a receiver's positive contact through a named package net.

zh-CN.text: 名称对应、极性交换或不同电压域连接，都须有批准接口规则，不能凭图猜测。
zh-CN.english: Matching names, exchanging polarity, or joining different voltage domains requires an approved interface rule, never a visual guess.

zh-CN.text: 俯瞰假设静态负载，CORE为8A，IO为2A。
zh-CN.english: Look down on the assumed static loads: eight amperes on CORE and two on IO.

zh-CN.text: 若均分，八个CORE接点各1A，四个IO接点各0.5A。
zh-CN.english: Equal sharing would give one ampere across each of eight CORE pads and half an ampere across each of four IO pads.

zh-CN.text: 两电源域均经八个参考接点回流时，简化平均为每个1.25A。
zh-CN.english: With both rails returning through the eight reference pads, the simplified average there is 1.25 amperes.

zh-CN.text: 这些平均值不能确立局部电流、物理接点额定、暂态行为或已验证电源网络。
zh-CN.english: These averages do not establish local current, physical pad ratings, transient behaviour, or a qualified power network.

zh-CN.text: 移到理想两节点电路，八条CORE供电支路并联，总电流固定8A。
zh-CN.english: Move to an ideal two-node circuit containing eight parallel CORE supply branches, with total current fixed at eight amperes.

zh-CN.text: 每条都是8毫欧时各流1A，但只把其中一条改成4毫欧，它便约流1.778A。
zh-CN.english: When every branch is eight milliohms, each carries one ampere, but reducing just one branch to four milliohms makes it carry about 1.778 amperes.

zh-CN.text: 即使平均仍为1A，该支路已超过假设的1.2A筛检门槛。
zh-CN.english: That exceeds our invented 1.2-ampere screening threshold even though the average remains one.

zh-CN.text: 电路说明不均流，不是测量凸块电阻或制造电流额定。
zh-CN.english: The circuit illustrates unequal sharing, not measured bump resistance or a manufacturing current rating.

zh-CN.text: 沿CORE的8A供电及共用参考回流前进，回流承载CORE的8A加IO的2A。
zh-CN.english: Follow CORE's eight-ampere supply and the shared reference return carrying eight CORE plus two IO amperes.

zh-CN.text: 假设CORE供电路径2毫欧、共用回流3毫欧，CORE供电压降为8乘2加10乘3，也就是46毫伏。
zh-CN.english: With a hypothetical two-milliohm CORE supply path and three-milliohm shared return, the CORE delivery drop is eight times two plus ten times three, or forty-six millivolts.

zh-CN.text: 它超出40毫伏预算，若错把两段都用8A计算，就会漏掉6毫伏。
zh-CN.english: That fails the forty-millivolt budget, while incorrectly using eight amperes for both paths would hide six millivolts.

zh-CN.text: 扣除30毫伏回流贡献后，CORE供电只剩10毫伏，因此最多允许1.25毫欧。
zh-CN.english: After the thirty-millivolt return contribution, only ten millivolts remain for CORE supply, allowing at most 1.25 milliohms.

zh-CN.text: 停在刻意错误的接点图，它违反明定契约，先旋转再镜射。
zh-CN.english: Freeze a deliberately wrong map that rotates before mirroring, contrary to the declared contract.

zh-CN.text: CORE接点B2落到原本接地G5的位置，但对称外框与接点总数仍可能看似合理。
zh-CN.english: Its CORE pad B2 lands at the position intended for ground pad G5, although the symmetric outline and total pad count still look plausible.

zh-CN.text: 应以独立坐标见证与具类型端点连接拒绝错配，不是重涂色块或豁免错误。
zh-CN.english: Reject the mismatch using independent coordinate witnesses and typed endpoint connectivity, rather than recolouring the square or waiving the error.

zh-CN.text: 在这张图中，再有利的电流平均也不能使供电接参考网络变成合格。
zh-CN.english: No amount of favourable current averaging makes a supply-to-reference connection acceptable in this map.

zh-CN.text: 拉远到交付记录，包含输入版本、坐标惯例、明示网络别名与每个已安装接点的身份。
zh-CN.english: Pull back to a release record containing the input revision, coordinate convention, explicit net aliases, and every installed pad's identity.

zh-CN.text: 附上方向与连接检查、电源预算假设、未解证据，以及批准变更历史。
zh-CN.english: Attach orientation and connectivity checks, power-budget assumptions, unresolved evidence, and the approved change history.

zh-CN.text: C04交付可追溯图供后续物理及电气验证，不宣称布线、可靠性或载流能力已签核。
zh-CN.english: C04 delivers a traceable map for later physical and electrical verification, not a claim that routing, reliability, or current capacity is already signed off.

zh-CN.text: C05便能使用同一受控接口基线，安排裸片并预留组装访问空间。
zh-CN.english: C05 can now place dies and reserve assembly access using the same controlled interface baseline.
